class.name: OcgGCMaketrimmedcylinder
class.brief_description: Implements construction algorithms for trimmed cylinders. The result is a `Geom_RectangularTrimmedSurface`. A MakeTrimmedCylinder provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the trimmed cylinder, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the results. In particular, the Value function returns the constructed trimmed cylinder.
class.description: ! Implements construction algorithms for trimmed cylinders. ! The result is a `Geom_RectangularTrimmedSurface`. ! A MakeTrimmedCylinder provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction of the trimmed cylinder, ! - implementing the construction algorithm, and ! - consulting the results. In particular, the Value ! function returns the constructed trimmed cylinder.

method.name: from_gp_Circ_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a trimmed cylindrical surface from a base circle and height.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref

method.name: from_gp_Ax1_const_ref_double_double
method.description: Creates a trimmed cylindrical surface from axis, radius and height.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed trimmed cylinder. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no trimmed cylinder is constructed.
